summary: __thiscall that initializes per-session weather, temperature and wetness state for a race-session data object. It builds a candidate list of session-type names (via SessionTypeNameLookup keyed on the global dword_7C56A4), searches the shared data-entry linked lists for the best matching session entry by a minutes/tick count, then reads 'conditions', track/on-path/off-path wetness, ambient temperature and track temperature entries, clamps the off-path wetness to be at least the on-path value, and finally builds a time-keyed linked list of weather snapshots (timestamp, ambient temp, wetness multiplier) starting from the selected session entry and walking the 'minute' entries. Returns -1 when no session entry is found, 0 on success.

Resolve session-name candidates: v51 = SessionTypeNameLookup(dword_7C56A4, 0) and v54 = SessionTypeNameLookup(7, 0).

Switch on dword_7C56A4 through jump table jpt_4FE397: session types map to up to two candidate session names, all resolved with SessionTypeNameLookup (v52/v53 slots of the (&v51)[0..3] candidate array).
Scan the candidate-name array (&v51)[v6] for the first non-null slot (v6 in 0..3); StringKeyedLinkedListSearch on that name yields the matching data entry a2, which stops the scan.
Return -1 when no data entry matched any candidate session name.
Compute the tick cutoff v50 = CRTFtol(100.0 / flt_8ACF9C + 0.5), a frames-per-unit conversion used as the lower bound for entry selection.
Read the selected entry's count v8 = sub_587ECE(DataEntryAccessor(a2)) and clamp it to 100 when non-positive.

Walk the linked list from a2 via ShortComputation_adb0, skipping entries whose StringPointerAccessor name equals the session name (sub_588410 match); select the entry whose count v12 is >= v50 and strictly below the running best v8.
Return -1 when no qualifying entry survived the best-fit scan.
Apply defaults: this+0x20, this+0x24, this+0x28 and this+0x2C = 0; this+0x30 = 20.0; this+0x34 = 22.0.
Look up the aConditions entry; when present, v49 = WeatherNameWetnessMultiplier(DataEntryAccessor(...)) and sub_4FDE00(this, v49) applies the base wetness.
Look up the aTrackwetness entry; when present, this+0x28 and this+0x2C are both set to WeatherSeverityGripMultiplier(DataEntryAccessor(...)).
Look up the aOnpathwetness entry; when present, this+0x28 = WeatherSeverityGripMultiplier(DataEntryAccessor(...)).
Look up the aOffpathwetness_0 entry; when present, this+0x2C = WeatherSeverityGripMultiplier(DataEntryAccessor(...)).
Clamp off-path wetness: when this+0x2C < this+0x28, set this+0x2C = this+0x28.
Look up the aAmbienttemp entry; when present, this+0x30 = sub_4FE2B0(...) and this+0x34 = this+0x30 + 2.0.
Look up the aTracktemp entry; when present, this+0x34 = sub_4FE2B0(DataEntryAccessor(...)).

Allocate the head weather node (16 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper, initialized by FloatArrayInitializer), store it at this+0x3C, then write node time 0, node ambient this+0x30 and node wetness v49, and set this+0x38 to the same node (head/tail cursor).
Choose the per-minute time scale v56 = flt_5EA408; when flt_5EA408 is below 16.0 or above 1024.0, fall back to 92.0.

Build the time-keyed weather snapshot chain from the aMinute entries: allocate a node per minute, copy the previous node's ambient/wetness into it, set its time from sub_58850F(DataEntryAccessor(...)) * 60.0 (later iterations scale by v56), refresh wetness from aConditions and ambient from aAmbienttemp, advance through ShortComputation_adb0, and stop at the off_5C330C terminator.
Fallback when no aMinute entry exists: resolve the chain seed from StringKeyedLinkedListSearch(&off_5C330C) and continue the snapshot walk from there.
Return 0 on success.
Invoked by sub_4FCC30 and sub_4FE7C0 to initialize session weather data.
